item.title: Quickstart
item.description: This guide walks you through installing Kure, generating one Flux Kustomization from Go, and handing it to Flux. It stays at the level of a single Kubernetes object. To build a whole cluster (Cluster, Node, Bundle, Application) and write the repository layout to disk, continue with the cluster-to-disk example . Installation You need the Go version that Kure’s go.mod declares. Create a module and add Kure: mkdir hello-kure && cd hello-kure go mod init example.com/hello-kure go get github.com/go-kure/kure@latest Hello World: Generate a Simple Cluster Config Create a minimal Go program that generates Kubernetes manifests.
